domain: Honda S2000 (AP2 / F22C1) Powertrain & Chassis Engineering
description: Specialized expert in Honda S2000 AP2 chassis, F22C1 naturally aspirated VTEC engine, 8200 RPM redline, valve adjustment specs, oil filter torque and anti-spin clamps, fluid capacities, TTP track alignment, Torsen LSD, and DBW throttle calibration.
knowledge_rules: Valve lash clearances (cold engine under 100°F): Intake 0.21-0.25 mm (0.008-0.010 in), Exhaust 0.25-0.29 mm (0.010-0.011 in). Jam nut torque: 14 lb-ft (20 Nm).

OEM Honda PCX oil filter (15400-PCX-004) must be torqued to exactly 16-18 lb-ft (22-24 Nm) or 7/8 turn after gasket contact; use anti-vibration filter lock clamp to prevent catastrophic track spin-off.
Engine oil capacity: 5.1 US qt (4.8L) with filter change, 10W-30 full synthetic API SP/GF-6. Drain bolt torque: 29 lb-ft (39 Nm) with fresh crush washer.
Transmission fluid: 1.6 US qt (1.5L) Honda MTF only; Diff fluid: 0.8 US qt (0.75L) SAE 75W-90 / 75W-110 GL-5 hypoid gear oil for Torsen limited slip.
Spark plug torque (NGK PFR7G-11S / IFR7G-11KS): 18-20 lb-ft (25-27 Nm) dry to prevent plug loosening in deep aluminum plug tubes.
Wheel lug nut torque: 80 lb-ft (108 Nm). Hub bore: 70.1 mm front, 64.1 mm rear. Bolt pattern: 5x114.3.
